definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture used for storing clothing. Can refer to a freestanding cabinet with shelves, a closet-like wardrobe, or open shelving for garments.

examples.japanese: {衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}した→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寝室|しんしつ}→寝室：05300_shinshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a new wardrobe in the bedroom.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きすぎて⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らなくて→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: When I moved, the wardrobe was too big to fit in the room and I was stuck.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧ (clothing, costume) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf, rack). Refers to any shelved or cabinet-style furniture for storing clothes, distinct from a built-in closet ({押|お}し{入|い}れ or ⟦クローゼット→クローゼット：04491_kuroozetto⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize the wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside the wardrobe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧: Western-style wardrobe — specifically a tall cabinet for hanging clothes
- ⟦クローゼット→クローゼット：04491_kuroozetto⟧: closet — a built-in storage space, often walk-in style
- {押|お}し{入|い}れ: Japanese-style closet — traditional sliding-door storage in tatami rooms, used for futons and clothing
- タンス: chest of drawers — a drawer-based furniture piece for folded clothing
